summary: North Cochrane District fire tower; a firelookout.ca note says it was in unusually good condition in 2016, and a former observer's cabin may survive.

events.note: A directory note on condition, not a formal survey

evidence.supports: listed in the North Cochrane District
tower in unusually good condition in 2016
evidence.quote: This tower was in peculiarly good condition in 2016.

evidence.supports: observer's cabin believed to still stand at the trailhead
evidence.quote: It is believed that the former observer's cabin still stands at the trailhead up the mountain.

notes_for_editor: One source only (firelookout.ca), and it is a short directory note. The record's 'standing' status rests on a 2016 remark, so a human should confirm the current status before publishing it as standing. The record has no height, tower type or build year, and the source gives none. The record's coordinates (48.638124, -80.330261) match the source's (48.63805, -80.33022) to within about 10 m. The Ontario geoHub tower dataset in source_pages gave no readable text. Two searches found no other page on this tower.
